$extensions.aesthetic: warm automation energy — friendly orange on cream canvas, playful but professional

surface.$description: Primary background — Bridal Heath, warm near-white with peach undertone

surface-subtle.$description: Secondary background for cards and sections — Serenade, warm cream with orange glow

surface-white.$description: Pure white for high-contrast containers, inputs, and modal overlays

surface-warm.$description: Warm interactive surface — light peach for button backgrounds and hover states

surface-dark.$description: Dark containers and elevated dark elements — espresso brown with orange warmth

surface-deep.$description: Dark-theme page background — Zapier Earth, cocoa-tinted near-black from brand.zapier.com

surface-overlay.$description: Transparent warm overlay for subtle elevation and depth on light surfaces

accent.$description: Primary action color — Zap Orange, International Orange per brand.zapier.com, the energy of automation

accent-hover.$description: Accent hover/pressed — slightly deeper orange for interactive feedback

accent-secondary.$description: Secondary accent — Pumpkin, warm sibling of Zap Orange for gradients and secondary emphasis

accent-tertiary.$description: Tertiary accent — Sunglow, warm gold for badges, highlights, and tertiary signals

accent-success.$description: Success accent — Java teal, used for connected/active Zap status indicators

accent-info.$description: Info accent — Picton Blue, used for informational states and links

text-primary.$description: Primary text — Zapier Earth, warm cocoa-black from brand palette, never pure black

text-secondary.$description: Secondary body text — warm brown-gray for descriptions and body copy

text-tertiary.$description: Tertiary text — warm taupe for metadata, timestamps, and de-emphasized content

text-button.$description: Button text on light warm surfaces — deep warm brown

text-link.$description: Link text — Zap Orange, consistent with primary accent for navigation signals

text-on-dark.$description: Text on dark surfaces — warm sand-tinted silver for readability on Earth backgrounds

text-on-accent.$description: Text on Zap Orange buttons — pure white for maximum contrast

error.$description: Error/danger state — warm red that harmonizes with orange palette without looking like accent

success.$description: Success state — Java teal, signals connected/active automation status

warning.$description: Warning state — Sunglow gold, warm alert without red urgency

focus.$description: Focus ring for inputs — Picton Blue, contrasts with warm palette for clear accessibility

border.$description: Default border — warm cream with peachy undertone, soft containment

border-subtle.$description: Subtle border — barely visible warm cream for card edges

border-prominent.$description: Prominent border — warm tan for section dividers and emphasized containment

border-dark.$description: Dark-theme border — deep warm brown maintaining orange-family warmth

border-accent.$description: Accent border — Zap Orange for active states, selected items, and focus indicators

font-headline.$description: Headline/display font — Degular by Oh No Type Co, Zapier's custom brand typeface for all headings

font-body.$description: Body/UI font — Inter for navigation, buttons, labels, and body text

font-mono.$description: Code font — for code blocks, API references, and Zap configuration snippets

scale-overline.$description: Uppercase overline labels — step labels, Zap status indicators

scale-label.$description: Badges, app labels, and small UI text — 0.75rem

scale-body.$description: Landing page body text — slightly larger for readability — 1.06rem

line-height-tight.$description: Tightest heading line-height — display and hero headings

line-height-heading.$description: Card titles and smaller headings — comfortable reading

line-height-relaxed.$description: Body text — readable and approachable, Zapier's friendly spacing

weight-regular.$description: Standard weight for body text, descriptions, and UI elements

weight-medium.$description: Medium weight for buttons, labels, and emphasized body text

weight-semibold.$description: Semibold for section headings and strong emphasis

weight-bold.$description: Bold for display headings and hero text — Degular at maximum presence

letter-spacing-tight.$description: Tighter tracking for display and hero headings in Degular

letter-spacing-wide.$description: Wide tracking for uppercase overline labels and step indicators

2xs.$description: Micro spacing — inline icon gaps, tight stacking

xs.$description: Extra small — badge padding, tight element gaps

sm.$description: Small — base unit, icon padding, compact gaps

md.$description: Medium — button padding, input internal spacing

lg.$description: Large — card internal padding, comfortable gaps

xl.$description: Extra large — section internal padding, card body spacing

3xl.$description: Large container padding, section breathing room

section-gap.$description: Standard vertical gap between major page sections

section-gap-lg.$description: Maximum vertical gap — hero sections, major page transitions

container-narrow.$description: Narrow container for text-focused sections and blog content

radius-none.$description: Sharp edge — used only for full-bleed sections

radius-sm.$description: Small radius — badges, tags, compact UI elements

radius-md.$description: Standard radius — buttons, inputs, small cards

radius-lg.$description: Large radius — feature cards, content containers

radius-xl.$description: Extra large — hero cards, Zap Builder containers, featured sections

radius-2xl.$description: Soft container — modal dialogs, marketing hero containers

radius-pill.$description: Fully rounded pill — tags, status badges, toggle switches

level-0.$description: Flat — no shadow, inline elements, flush containers

level-1.$description: Subtle — warm micro-lift for cards and resting interactive elements

level-2.$description: Medium — warm elevation for hover states, dropdowns, and floating UI

level-3.$description: Elevated — warm lift for modals, Zap Builder panels, and featured content

level-glow.$description: Orange glow — Zap Orange halo for active automation states and featured CTAs

button-primary.$description: Primary button — subtle depth with inner highlight for 3D feel on Zap Orange

duration-normal.$description: Standard transitions — button presses, toggle switches, focus rings

duration-slow.$description: Deliberate transitions — modal entrances, Zap step animations, panel slides

duration-zap.$description: Zap execution animation — the signature lightning-bolt moment

easing-bounce.$description: Playful bounce — Zap connection animations, success states, celebration moments

easing-snap.$description: Quick snap — step transitions, workflow builder connections

sm-mobile.$description: Small mobile — single column, stacked Zap steps

mobile.$description: Mobile — compact layout, simplified automation visuals

desktop.$description: Desktop — full multi-column layout, expanded Zap Builder

wide.$description: Wide desktop — maximum container width, enhanced dashboard layouts
